bybit.field: timestamp, Unix seconds as decimal text

explanation.0 ms: The earlier provider_cross_check.json field timestamp_abs_diff_ms was computed as abs(diff_us) // 1000, which floors 0-900 us to 0. It was a truncated display, not an exact difference. The field is now timestamp_abs_diff_us.
explanation.0.9 ms: Exact maximum of |Bybit - Tardis| in integer microseconds, reported by scripts/verify_tardis_trades.py. Correct.
explanation.cause_of_the_nonzero_difference: Tardis values are whole milliseconds and Bybit CSV values carry 0.1 ms precision. Flooring both to ms makes every pair equal, so the observed difference is precision, not a disagreement about the trade.

normalization.side: Bybit Buy/Sell lower-cased, then equal to Tardis buy/sell
